proposal.name: Give plumbing agents their repository's context

plan.name: Give plumbing agents their repository's context
plan.summary: Carry a shared repository context from the caller's captured base configuration into plumbing planning and revisions, plans of issues, initial builds, fallbacks, both repairs and every read-only review: identify declared current-state documents, root and applicable nested agent rules with their captured contents and readable workspace copies, part directories and shared ownership, declared command argv and inapplicable reasons, native acceptance identities, captured regression conventions and human-merge paths. Render repository-specific instructions for Go, pytest, Vitest and Jest, use captured rules rather than candidate or working-tree replacements, and state that repository guidance cannot expand the immutable plan, acceptance or regression boundaries; preserve the built-in Invariant documentation and merger-work instructions, existing test and execution budgets and two-repair lifecycle, while other repositories receive only their own declared documentation policies and never acquire Invariant's SPEC, README line limit, decision journal or real-suite obligations from filenames. Make proposal and pull-request posts describe the applicable regression allowance, complete native selectors and verbatim language-tagged sources, and configured check results including inapplicable phases instead of promising Go-only checks; update the external-intake refusal and its existing test to identify configuration drafting and generated CI as the remaining prerequisites. Keep modeled-project synthesis, ratification hashes and locks, execution and scope authority, disabled external plumbing intake and the absence of decision-followup automation unchanged. Update SPEC.md with citations to recorded foundations, README.md within its 400-line limit and docs/factory.md to describe this context delivery and the remaining intake boundary; this step needs a new decision recorded by its merger before the next step, without the build writing decisions/.

tests.name: TestPlumbingPlannerReceivesCapturedRepositoryContext708
tests.says: Initial and revised plumbing requests describe captured Go, pytest, Vitest and Jest parts, commands, documents and nested rules without importing Invariant policies or trusting working-tree replacements.

tests.name: TestIssuePlannerReceivesCapturedRepositoryContext708
tests.says: The plan-of-issues agent receives the same captured monorepo context and readable rules.

tests.name: TestBuildFallbackRepairsAndReviewsKeepCapturedContext708
tests.says: Initial builds, fallback, both repairs and all read-only reviews receive captured rules, checks, native identities and documents for each supported language and a nested monorepo, preserving the original plan, acceptance, scope and shared allowance despite candidate rule edits.

tests.name: TestNativeProposalExplainsCapturedRegressionConventions708
tests.says: Native proposals explain Python and TypeScript regression scope and display full identities, exact source and human-merge paths without changing the pinned proposal.

tests.name: TestConfiguredPullRequestPostsDescribeActualChecks708
tests.says: Fresh and recovered configured build posts describe actual part checks, inapplicable phases and native frameworks rather than promising gofmt or go vet, while built-in Invariant posts keep their checks.

tests.name: TestExternalPlumbingRefusalNamesRemainingIntakeWork708
tests.says: External intake stays disabled and its single refusal describes configuration and CI prerequisites without obsolete prompt or dependency limitations.

usage.summary: Wrote [plan.json](/var/folders/fz/s3p17rl97r30y73d180fjbmc0000gn/T/invariant-plan-2547963267/plan.json) and six acceptance tests covering repository context across planning, builds, repairs, reviews, and factory posts. The first check passed, and `repo/` remains unchanged.
